This error caused the entire subsequent search trajectory to shift away from the correct city (Toronto) and towards an incorrect one (Coventry), leading to a failure to identify the correct castle (Casa Loma) and instead searching for a non-existent or less relevant castle in Coventry. The Planner failed to verify the conflicting information (Toronto vs. Coventry) with a primary authoritative source like Wikipedia before making a definitive decision, instead accepting the ambiguous/incorrect snippet as truth.
